items.title: Covers and degree bounds for a quasi-compact quasi-separated space, and the resulting vanishing above the maximum of the bounds
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma provides, for a quasi-compact quasi-separated algebraic space, a system of affine covers and degree bounds whose maximum controls the cohomological dimension for quasi-coherent sheaves (statement lines 1384-1401). The proof builds the data using boundedness of fibres and the configuration quotients, checks that those quotients are quasi-compact and separated, feeds them into the alternating Cech spectral sequence, and kills the $E_1$-terms in the required range by the separated vanishing result combined with quasi-coherence of the twists. The bookkeeping of the spectral sequence range is the substance, so the claim is H2.
